Zuko Suspended

By: Tarryn Crossman | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
6 months after we broke the story on corrupt litigation lawyer Zuko Nonxuba, he has finally been suspended. And the LPC are now on their way to getting him struck from the roll, but why has it taken the LPC nearly a decade.
Finally we go face to face with the Legal practice council, the governing body that has allowed Nonxuba and rogue lawyers like him to thrive.

Not only has the LPC finally taken action, but these families who 6 months ago didn't even know they had been robbed of millions and left in abject poverty, now have a team of some of the top legal brains in South Africa ensuring that they get what is owed to them.

The fight is finally even, and this time Zuko Nonxuba may just get what he deserves.

Beats
The recap
The LPC - create a bigger picture of who they are.
That they are lawyers holding lawyers accountable, which is faulty.
The 14 lawyer investigation they were bragging about - this isn't the same as the SIU one, so I am trying to find out the details. - The bigger picture
The Legal power team - coming in to even the playing field
The NPA/ The Hawks and the criminal case

complaints

But, because he was also..facing criminal charges it refused to investigate
In 2019 the High Court ordered the LPC to investigate the complaints and a year

However, he appealed to the constitutional court, which stopped his suspension and

We've done two previous stories on the children left in the lurch by Zuko Nonxuba. In both,
